mapper.update: UPDATE Location SET Name = #{locationName}, Phone = #{phone}, LocX = #{locationX}, LocY = #{locationY}, Address = #{mainAddress}, AddressDetail = #{detailAddress}, Area = #{area}, Map = null, Descritpion = #{description} WHERE ID = #{ID}
